scenes.headline: How the open Jev alternatives read a decision
scenes.sub: Seven open models, one shared yardstick, and what sealed items show.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Anise! Week two brought seven open models built to answer like Jev.

scenes.text: Every alternative reads a decision one of three ways, and the way it reads decides what can go wrong.
scenes.say: How each one reads a decision decides what can go wrong.

scenes.title: Three ways to read a decision

steps.say: State and options go through a backbone, usually Qwen with a small adapter.
A letter readout reads the logits of lettered options. Order matters, and the alphabet caps the list.
A per-option scorer gives each option one number, alone. Order cannot matter.
A pointer, Kev's family, lays options in one shared row and points at one. Order matters again.

scenes.title: Open-Jev's head starts as a reader
scenes.say: Open-Jev's head is one linear layer, one output.

parts.note: step zero is the base model's own yes-minus-no readout
parts.say: It starts as the base model's yes minus no readout, so training begins from a working reader.

parts.note: one number per candidate, softmax over the candidates
parts.say: The softmax runs over the candidates' numbers.

scenes.title: The recipe's fixed slot
scenes.say: One training-data recipe has a quiet bug.

items.say: One call writes a question, its answer and distractors.
Each is shuffled by a fresh generator with the same seed.
So with four options the answer is always D. With three, always B.
A model that sees order can learn the slot, not the passage.

scenes.credit: Lev's model card; its own measurements
scenes.title: A head-to-head it loses

steps.say: Lev measured Jev on the same items and harness, and published the chart it loses.
Jev wins ten of thirteen. The widest gap, Lev reports, is one its fine-tuning broke.

scenes.title: Same benchmark, public and sealed items
scenes.say: On public items XOR leads Jev by three points. On sealed items both fall, and XOR trails by almost three.

scenes.text: Ask which items a number sits on, and who ran them. Public leads of a few points can invert on sealed items.
scenes.say: Ask which items a number sits on, and who ran them.

recap: Letters, single scores or pointers: order behaves differently
Public-item leads can invert on sealed items
Trust the releases that publish their losses
scenes.say: To recap: know the family, check the items, and trust the ones that publish their losses.
